title: Change a user's home directory
summary: Move a user's home directory to a new location and update their account settings.

steps.explain: Change the user's home directory to the new path. The -m flag moves the contents of the old home directory to the new one.

placeholders.name: NEW_HOME_PATH
placeholders.description: The new path for the user's home directory

rollback.explain: Move the home directory back to the original path.

placeholders.name: OLD_HOME_PATH
placeholders.description: The original path of the user's home directory

warnings: Ensure the user is not logged in when performing this action.
Verify that the new home directory path does not already exist or is empty to avoid data loss.
Update any configuration files or scripts that reference the old home directory path.
